mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by >1pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and depress S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS exceeds 5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate, defined as a 0.5pp rise over 3 months, signals a weakening labor market and slowing consumer demand that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises >0.5pp in 3mo but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production, measured by a 0.5% month-over-month drop in the INDPRO index, signals supply chain disruptions and slowing economic activity that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: M-o-m INDPRO declines >0.5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When both housing starts and retail sales decline month-over-month, it signals weakening consumer demand that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Concurrent m-o-m declines in HOUST and RSAFS, but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate is above 6% and payroll employment growth is negative month-over-month, it signals a weakening labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 6% and PAYEMS declines m-o-m, but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 4% and the CPI inflation rate is above 3%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL > 3%, but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP growth is positive but retail sales are declining month-over-month, it signals a disconnect between overall economic growth and consumer spending that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 q-o-q growth > 0% and RSAFS m-o-m decline
failure_condition: GDPC1 growing q-o-q but RSAFS declining m-o-m, and SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.
